title: Linguistic Nepotism: Trading-off Quality for Language Preference in Multilingual RAG
authors: Dayeon Ki; Marine Carpuat; Paul McNamee; Daniel Khashabi; Eugene Yang; Dawn Lawrie; Kevin Duh
